$comment: targetUbr is the single most important field. It is the UBR (the fourth
part of the build number, e.g. the 4890 in 22631.4890) that the machine
will report AFTER this month's update installs. It is published in every
KB article under 'this update ... increments the build to'. Setting it
lets a session host decide in milliseconds whether it needs patching at
all, with no DISM call and no download. Leave it at 0 and the installer
falls back to a slower KB-presence check.
Update targetUbr each month as part of the change that approves the
cycle. Docs/runbook.md describes where to find it.
